ordering.title: Ordering guide
ordering.intro: Orders at Radiatorchi are handled by direct contact. Here is how it works:

steps.title: Find the product
steps.text: Search the Products section or start from the categories.

steps.title: Check compatibility
steps.text: If compatible vehicles are listed for a product, you will see them on its page. Otherwise, ask when you contact us.

steps.title: Contact us
steps.text: Use the “Contact to order” button to choose phone, email or WhatsApp, and mention the product name.

steps.title: Finalize the details
steps.text: Confirm availability, price, purchase terms and delivery with the Radiatorchi team.

ordering.notice: No online payment is processed on this website, and no order is placed through it.

legal.privacyIntro: This page explains how the Radiatorchi website handles your information.

privacy.title: Information we collect
privacy.body: This website has no sign-up, account or order form, and it does not collect your personal information through the site itself.

privacy.title: Direct contact
privacy.body: When you contact us by phone, email or WhatsApp, the information you provide is used to answer your request. That communication is subject to the policies of the channel you choose.

privacy.title: Display preferences
privacy.body: Your language and theme choices may be stored in your browser so they are kept on your next visit.

privacy.title: Changes
privacy.body: This policy may be updated. The current version is always published on this page.

legal.termsIntro: By using this website you accept the terms below.

terms.title: Nature of the website
terms.body: This website is the Radiatorchi product catalog. It offers no online shop, online payment or order placement.

terms.title: Product information
terms.body: Product information is provided as guidance. Confirm compatibility and availability with the Radiatorchi team before buying.

terms.title: Prices and availability
terms.body: Prices and stock are not shown on this website and are confirmed when you contact us.

terms.title: Delivery, returns and warranty
terms.body: Delivery, return and warranty terms are communicated when you order, according to Radiatorchi's current policies.
